Based on the range of each sample, which sample is more consistent (less variable)?” and require the reasoning for each step before another attempt.

identify-population-vs-sample (7.SP.1): if the learner misses these, reteach with the worked example “A researcher wants to know about all 400 students at Lincoln Middle School. She randomly selects 40 of them to survey. What is the sample in this situation?” and require the reasoning for each step before another attempt.

sampling-method-bias-analysis (7.SP.1): if the learner misses these, reteach with the worked example “A student wants to know the favorite lunch food of her whole school. She only surveys the 10 friends at her lunch table. Is this method likely to produce a representative sample?” and require the reasoning for each step before another attempt.

estimate-population-from-sample-proportion (7.SP.2): if the learner misses these, reteach with the worked example “In a random sample of 20 students, 8 preferred pizza. Based on this sample, about how many of the 200 students in the school would you expect to prefer pizza?” and require the reasoning for each step before another attempt.
